scope: 44 newly assigned scenes; final source availability is recorded separately in review-source.json
criteria: The background defines the petroleum object, measured quantities, units and the operational question before naming the model.
Concept and process figures support specific prose, with substantial data charts in the running demonstration.
Each engine performs its scenario-specific calculation; a shared rendering shell is acceptable, a renamed identical model is not.
Training labels may be read by fitting; held-out reference labels must be used only after prediction for evaluation or display.
Actual numerical comparisons, null metrics and results where the baseline is better remain visible.
Source/VM checks do not establish browser operation, importer operation or persistence.

findings.issue: An unmatched-boundary MAE was converted from null to zero, which would falsely imply perfect accuracy.
findings.resolution: Author retained null, UI renders an em dash, and the matched-boundary count is included in the unit label.

findings.issue: Training and test seeds initially changed noise only while keeping identical fracture geometry.
findings.resolution: Author varied phase, amplitude, center depth and stripe position with the seed. Default Dice after this change is approximately 0.765, rather than hiding the harder test.

findings.issue: The control compensation target must not replace the original intended target in the reported terminal error.
findings.resolution: Author now reports endpoint distance to the original target; compensated target is used only for constructing the controller action.

findings.issue: The original short background moved too quickly to formulation, activity and ellipse parameters without sufficient explanation of chemical flooding, microbial mechanisms or half-length/half-height.
findings.requestedResolution: Add concrete petroleum mechanism paragraphs and figure-specific captions while keeping illustrations supplementary.
findings.resolution: Added chemical-flood mobility/interface mechanisms, microbial metabolite/environment context, complete length=2L and complete height=2H, and figure-specific captions.

findings.issue: Actual teacher sandbox uses an opaque-origin about:srcdoc. Unguarded history.replaceState threw SecurityError, stopping initialization in six solidification/completion cases and throwing during tab changes in other affected cases.
findings.resolution: Root wrapped optional URL bookmarking in rememberTab try/catch; actual panel switching remains outside the optional operation, preserving the teacher sandbox instead of relaxing iframe permissions.
findings.browserScopeBoundary: Reviewer read root-produced actual browser logs; original-site representative executions do not imply every affected case was independently sandbox-executed by this reviewer.

manualTruthBoundaryReview.finding: Scoring/prediction takes observed indicator values, pixels, attributes or noisy traces; reference values are consumed by metric functions after prediction.

Test observations are fed to the fitted residual, regression, classification, segmentation or neighbor calculation. The original target in d3 is a requested control target; w5 masked RHOB is excluded from neighbor input.

Learned surrogate prediction uses operation inputs. co2 is an explicit finite expert-constraint search. co4 predicts candidate responses from visible state, then advances the simulated plant only after action selection.

t2 reference identity is read for matching accuracy only; t3 is finite constrained search; t4 correction uses calibrated coefficients; t5 inference receives pixels. Refining predictors receive measured inputs/parsed records; r4 custom text correctly disables label-based metrics.

Knowledge constraints, background residual segmentation, normal residual alarms, regression or neighbor predictors use observations/candidates/training records. In wo3 the local mask is thresholded before its overlap is scored against the reference.

p2 regressions consume material inputs; p3 applies explicit catalog constraints; p4 subtracts learned operating-condition changes from observed before/after production; pr2 recursively appends predictions to historical values and applies intervention only to future evaluation; pr3 ranks feasible allocations using learned layer responses; pr4 residual alarms use load/current/temperature; pr5 strips held-out labels before inference. Seven sets of petroleum background paragraphs were read and linked to their displayed plots.

browserEvidence: None generated by this reviewer. Root browser acceptance reports must be consulted separately.
